skills.name: coding-agents-collab-contributor
skills.description: Implement assigned tasks as a contributor in a multi-agent GitHub project. Read the handoff, work on an assigned branch, verify changes, record evidence, and open a PR for the project leader. Route merge and release to the leader.

skills.name: coding-agents-collab-leader
skills.description: Lead a multi-agent GitHub project. Set scope, assign contributors, review evidence, merge approved pull requests, handle authorized releases, and maintain the project handoff. Use when designated as project leader.

skills.name: hallmark-web-design
skills.description: Use Hallmark Web Design when asked to design distinctive websites or interfaces, audit UI for generic AI-design patterns, or explicitly redesign an existing site while preserving functionality. Also trigger for Hallmark and anti-AI-slop design requests; do not silently redesign existing products.

skills.name: hanyu-visual-lab
skills.description: Build one or more Chinese–Pinyin–Vietnamese kawaii educational infographic images from either a three-column vocabulary/phrase table (Data Mode) or a topic/request (Topic Mode). Plans lessons, validates language, designs textless illustrations, lays out exact multilingual typography in code, runs visual QA, and exports PNG plus editable HTML and JSON.

skills.name: klein-explorer
skills.description: Use when the user asks Klein Explorer to research, brainstorm, map an unfamiliar domain, discover overlooked opportunities, compare alternatives, or devise a strategy without relying solely on the user's initial framing.

skills.name: universal-project-repository
skills.description: Set up, resume, audit or hand off durable human–AI projects across software, fiction, comics, research, philosophy, business and mixed domains. Use for new project repositories, substantial checkpoints, canon or specification updates, repository adoption and independent review packets. Skip routine edits and one-off chats unless they affect a durable project record.

skills.name: wonderanime-gouache-grungecel-image
skills.description: Apply the WonderAnime Gouache/Grungecel house style to image generation, reference-based editing, or prompt writing. Use when asked for WonderAnime, WonderAnime V3, Grungecel, or the WonderAnime house style.
